item.tib: phywa g.yang sgrub pa'i tshogs kyi cha lag dgos 'dod gter ldan
item.coloph: ces dngos grub g.yang gi sgrab pa'i las kha tshogs kyi shog chung dgos 'dod zad med gter ldan 'di yang / ston pa 'chi med gtsug phud nas rim par brgyud nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la bstan te/ rgyas 'bring rim par phyes nas/ grol thob sems dpa' brgyad la gdams nas spyod do/ dus der g.yung drung bon bstan gter du gshegs/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis gter kha cha gnyis phyes nas/ zab mo gter du sbas/ phyis su smon lam dus la bab tshe/ stang chen dmu tsha'i pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am g.yung drung thogs med rtsa la du 'bod pa la bka' gter tshig dril du dngos grub tu bab pa'o/ de la snying slob las skal ldan cing bstan 'gro'i grogs por gyur ba'i shes rab phun tshogs dang / dad ldan 'ga' yis bskur (bskul) ngor/ dkar chag yi ger shar grol smin gling du btab pa'o//
